excluded_with_reason.L3: terminal Ca only, slow sensor, no voltage/release data (Silies 2013)
excluded_with_reason.R7/R8: identity+receptor genetics, no release-mode evidence (Gao 2008); Ca imaging cannot distinguish graded from spike-driven
excluded_with_reason.13A/13B/9A adult recordings: Agrawal et al.: recordings exist but no release-mode evidence in adult Drosophila

enabled_cross_species_hypothesis._approval: Robin, 2026-08-19: 'if it's smartest to do something with graded synapses we should do it. just tell me what' -- cross-species homology adopted as a WORKING HYPOTHESIS, not as adult-fly evidence. Every result produced under this set carries the HYPOTHESIS label.

enabled_cross_species_hypothesis.rationale: premotor interneurons fire 4-9 Hz against a 10-24 Hz gait cycle -- a spike-rate code undersamples inter-leg phase; three fly-wbe constraint families (coord.tri_index, cmd.MDN_direction, cmd.DNg100_dose) fail in the direction this mechanism predicts

enabled_pugliese_oscillator_hypothesis._approval: Robin, 2026-09-01: apply graded transmission to neurons known graded or that could be. Pugliese/Tuthill oscillator types are the walking-relevant could-be set. Default-off, hypothesis-labelled, searchable. Not adult-Drosophila release evidence; do not copy into 'enabled'.
